# Customer Escalation Call: AutoDrive Systems

Date: 2025-04-02

## Attendees

- Mike O'Brien - Sales Director
- Jennifer Liu - Quality Manager
- David Park

## Notes

Mike O'Brien: AutoDrive reported three field returns of Eagle-5 parts with brown-out resets. Their production line is at risk of stopping next week.

Jennifer Liu: We opened an 8D report. Initial analysis links the returns to lot 4412, the same lot from the yield excursion.

David Park: We can expedite replacement parts from the Penang test facility within five days.

Decision: Ship replacement parts from Penang and provide AutoDrive a containment report by Friday.

Action: Jennifer Liu to deliver the 8D containment report to AutoDrive by April 4.
